value.rationale: Fixed-total branch-length optimization of the sharp path integration constant is natural for metric-tree Hardy/Poincaré theory. Strict majorization orders all asymmetric profiles, the complete equality description and explicit Hessian quantify sharp balancing, and the many-arm endpoint-mass limit with its exact second-order correction gives a nontrivial singular geometric limit. These are structural infinite-family facts, not a trivial restatement of the known total-length bound.
